bibliographic.title: Visita al Marconi
bibliographic.author: G. Marconi and Marco Vallarino
bibliographic.description: This is an educational text adventure produced by an Italian high-school to promote its structures and lessons. You play the role of a kid who has to choose which high-school to enrol: you may visit the edifice and take aptitude tests to know which subjects you prefer among information technology, electronics, mechanical engineering, hydraulics. You have to repair a radiator, change the oil in a car, translate a text from English to Italian, make a printed circuit board, program a chip, build a little robot. There is also a final secret test. The game is illustrated by the photos of the school rooms and equipment.
